name: Themadhood leather wraped Braser
shortDescription: My first leather project: a single-piece Themadhood-logo bracer wrapped with thick leather cord and designed to slip on without buckles or ties.
description: This was my first leather project. The bracer was made from a single piece of leather bearing the Themadhood logo, then wrapped with a thick leather cord and finished with a dark leather finish.
I designed it to slip directly on and off my arm, so it did not require buckles or ties. As far as I know, no photographs of the original bracer still exist.
